_source: ServUO, Scripts/Items/Functional/Doors.cs. Every BaseDoor subclass is base(closed + 2 * facing, closed + 1 + 2 * facing, ...) over the eight DoorFacing values, so a family is sixteen consecutive graphics: even offsets shut, odd offsets swung open.
_why: Nothing in the client's own files says which of a door's graphics is the open one. tiledata.mul gives an open leaf exactly the flags of its shut twin - measured, identical in all 104 pairs; the DOOR flag comes in runs of 1 to 98 graphics so there is no parity to read off the layout; and 'an open leaf's picture is wider than a tile' holds for 46 of the 104 because a door swung to four of the eight facings is still 44 across. See docs/lighting.md, decision 11.
